question: The arithmetic mean of the observations 28, 31, 40, 63, 57, 37, 34, 70 and 99 is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Assume an **assumed mean** of 50.

Calculate **deviations** from 50: −22, −19, −10, +13, +7, −13, −16, +20, +49.

Net deviation = (−22 − 19 − 10 − 13 − 16) + (13 + 7 + 20 + 49) = −80 + 89 = +9.

Average deviation = 9 ÷ 9 = +1.

Actual Mean = Assumed Mean + Average Deviation = 50 + 1 = 51.

**∴ The correct answer is 51.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Observations are 28, 31, 40, 63, 57, 37, 34, 70, and 99.

**Formula Used:** Arithmetic Mean = (Sum of all observations) ÷ (Total number of observations)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a911a5d8c44ed39bfa1927880f845c3381b551c7250b6f73d7baf3b89e34112.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Total number of observations (n) = 9

⇒ Sum of observations = 28 + 31 + 40 + 63 + 57 + 37 + 34 + 70 + 99

⇒ Sum = 459

⇒ Arithmetic Mean = 459 ÷ 9

⇒ Arithmetic Mean = 51

**∴ The correct answer is 51.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Properties of Arithmetic Mean

The sum of **deviations** of a set of observations from their arithmetic mean is always zero. If each observation is increased by a constant 'k', the mean also increases by 'k'.

Median

The **Median** is the middle value when observations are arranged in ascending order. For n = 9, it is the (9+1)÷2 = 5th term.

Relationship between Mean, Median, and Mode

For a moderately skewed distribution: **Mode = 3 × Median − 2 × Mean**.</p
